{{Quote|Here's a slider for those who like things neat 'n tidy. We serve this one up with a single patty and a precisely measured amount of strider cheese sauce--nothing more, nothing less. It's perfection every time! |Dex's Diner menu, on the Khomm slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''Khomm slider''' was a simple [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] created and served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] was inspired by the travels of [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]], and was named<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> after the planet<ref name="Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region.<ref name="Guide to Planets and Moons" /> The slider was made with a single [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-formed [[Mongo Beefhead patty]] with [[strider cheese sauce]] on a [[medium-density food-board]]. It cost 6.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was served with the diner's [[Slider garnish|special garnish]]. The diner offered [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] free of charge upon request. The Khomm slider could also be bought alongside another basic slider as a [[Talus and Tralus slider]] meal at the diner.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khomm sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
